name: mailcall
description: Claude reads your mailbox for you and writes the morning summary: what is important, who is waiting for your answer, and a short digest of your Google Alerts and newsletters in your own words. Main road: the Gmail connector of your Claude subscription, no passwords anywhere. Spare road for any mailbox: IMAP strictly read-only, with an app password you type yourself into the system's own keychain, never into a file. Reply drafts only; nothing is sent, deleted or marked without your yes. No keys, no paid API.
